create_builder_config: create a Builder instance with language-specific Universal Dependencies configs from ud_utils.LANGS
build_dataset_info: build dataset metadata using create_dataset_info with the Universal Dependencies homepage URL
download_and_extract_splits: download and extract Universal Dependencies CoNLL-U files per split using dl_manager.download_and_extract
generate_examples: generate examples from downloaded CoNLL-U filepaths for each data split
prepare_ud_filepaths: prepare Universal Dependencies filepaths with a base URL prefix for download
